---
title: A subfigure group from Julia
engine: julia
---

```{julia}
#| label: fig-one
#| fig-cap: One figure.
using Plots
display(MIME("image/png"), plot(1:3))
```

```{julia}
#| label: fig-two
#| fig-cap: A group.
#| fig-subcap:
#|   - First.
#|   - Second.
#| layout-ncol: 2
display(MIME("image/png"), plot(1:4))
display(MIME("image/png"), plot((1:4) .^ 2))
```

```{julia}
#| label: tbl-one
#| tbl-cap: A table.
using Markdown
display(MIME("text/markdown"), md"| a | b |\n|---|---|\n| 1 | 2 |")
```

References: @fig-one, @fig-two, @fig-two-1, @fig-two-2, @tbl-one.
